en: Black-and-white winter scene of a small snowy town or village. A wide snow-covered street runs downhill between wooden houses and a plain three-story building with shops on the ground floor. Two children are walking or pulling sleds along the road. Evergreen and leafless trees surround the buildings, and there are low wooded hills in the background. Christmas lights appear strung between some trees and over a fence, and there are a few road signs partly buried in snow.
